model.description: Model ID in 'provider/model' format (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash'). Bare IDs like 'gpt-4o' are treated as 'openai/gpt-4o' for backward compatibility.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt string OR a relative path to a .md/.txt file (init scaffolds ./agent/system-prompt.md).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model can generate per round.

maxRounds.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per run before the agent is force-stopped.

tools.description: Map of tool name → relative path to a .ts file that exports `defineTool(...)` as default.

actionBlocks.description: Map of tool name → relative path to a React component (.tsx) for in-stream UI cards.

skills.description: Array of relative paths to Markdown skill documents the agent can read via read_skill.

context.description: Array of relative paths to .ts files that each export a default async function () => Promise<string>. Gluon calls every provider fresh on each agent request and injects the returned strings into the system prompt under a '## Context' block.

handler.description: "allow" | "deny" | relative path to a .ts file that default-exports async (req: Request) => string | boolean | null.

hooks.description: Relative path to a .ts file that exports optional { onRunStart, onRunEnd, onRunError } hooks.

sendReasoning.description: Whether to stream reasoning tokens (chain-of-thought) to the client by default. Can also be set per-request by the client.

reasoningModel.description: Model to use when Think mode is active (sendReasoning: true). Must be a reasoning-capable model such as 'openai/o4-mini' or 'openai/o3'. Falls back to 'model' when not set.

suggestedPrompts.description: Suggested prompts shown in the empty-state UI.

worker.description: Whether to enable the BullMQ background worker.

workerConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent jobs the worker processes.

env.description: Remap environment variable names if they differ from the defaults.

gatewayApiKey.description: Name of the env var holding the Vercel AI Gateway API key.

databaseUrl.description: Name of the env var holding the agent database connection string.

redisUrl.description: Name of the env var holding the Redis connection string.

db.description: Database adapter settings. Omit for built-in Prisma + PostgreSQL.

provider.description: Provider for the built-in Prisma adapter. Ignored when adapter is set.

adapter.description: Relative path to a custom GluonDatabaseAdapter module. When set, built-in Prisma is not used.
